tasks.title: Derive wall PAINT area (perimeter x height) — the missing painting measurement
tasks.notes: A 2D plan has no wall height so painting gets ZERO auto-sqft today. Add wall/ceiling height input (project default + optional per-room override); wall paint SF/room = perimeter x height.

prep.what: Add a wall-height input so painting measurements emit a real 'Wall paint SF' line instead of zero — the seeder currently has no height and drops the perimeter data needed to compute it.
prep.understand: The takeoff engine returns 2D floor plan data: rooms have floor `area` (SF) and `perimeter` (LF from `geometry.rings` / `meta.perimeter`) but NO height. Wall paint area = perimeter × height. Today `TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php` drops `geometry` entirely — you need to preserve perimeter AND add a height input. Wall height is a user-supplied value, not engine data.
approach: Create a migration to add `wall_height_ft` (nullable decimal) to the `estimates` table for the project-level default
In `TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php`, stop dropping `geometry.rings` / `meta.perimeter` — store the perimeter so the wall SF calc can use it
Compute `wall_paint_sf = perimeter × wall_height_ft` per room and emit as a 'Wall paint area' estimate line item
Add a height input field to the Takeoff Vue component (or the measurement seeding flow) and verify the new line appears in the estimate editor
resources: `TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php` — the seeder that ingests engine measurement rows into estimate lines
`Takeoff/Index.vue` or the Review widget — where to add the wall-height project input
Migration: `add_wall_height_ft_to_estimates` (nullable decimal, default null)
`engine/assemblies.py` reference for how `perimeter` and `area` fields are named in the engine output

tasks.title: Route takeoff measurements to trades at the seam
tasks.notes: Every measurement collapses into one anonymous kind=custom $0 line, dropping kind+geometry. Preserve+switch on kind: area(SF)->flooring, derived wall SF->painting, line(LF)->wall-linear/trim, count(EA)->doors/tile.

prep.what: Make `TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php` switch on `kind` so each measurement routes to the correct trade line (flooring, painting, trim, tile) instead of collapsing into anonymous $0 custom lines.
prep.understand: The engine returns `kind` on every measurement — `area` (SF for floors/rooms), `line` (LF for trim/wall-linear), `count` (EA for doors/tile). Right now the seeder ignores `kind`. Rafa said 'quanto de tile, quanto de trim, quanto de tudo' — trades must be separated at seeding time. The wall-derived SF from t45 feeds the painting line here.
approach: Open `TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php` and find where estimate lines are created from engine measurement rows
Add a `switch` on `kind`: `area` → flooring trade, derived wall SF → painting trade, `line` → wall-linear/trim trade, `count` → doors/tile trade
Tag each line using the existing core-vs-subbed helper to set the correct trade flag on the line item
Smoke-test by seeding a takeoff project and checking the estimate shows separate flooring, painting, and trim lines
resources: `TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php` — single-file change, the switch goes in the line-creation loop
Engine `kind` enum values (area/line/count) — check `README-SERVICE.md` or the `§8 routes` docs
Core-vs-subbed helper (grep `fromSubcontract` or `tradeTag` in the codebase)
Any trade taxonomy enum/constants in `app/Enums/` to use for trade assignment

tasks.title: Add PerLinearFt RateType (prerequisite for pricing trim/wall-linear)
tasks.notes: RateType has no per-linear-foot option. Add PerLinearFt='per_linear_ft' + label, wire LineItemFactory::unitFromRateType->'lf', seed a per-LF trim LaborRate. Must land before takeoff pricing (t48).

prep.what: Add `per_linear_ft` to the `RateType` enum so trim and wall-linear lines seeded in t46 can carry a real price — a 30-min prerequisite for t48.
prep.understand: The `RateType` enum controls how estimate lines calculate totals. Without a LF rate type, `line`-kind measurements routed in t46 have no valid pricing unit and seed at $0. This is a small enum + seeder change. Check for any exhaustive switches on `RateType` that need updating.
approach: Add `PerLinearFt = 'per_linear_ft'` to `app/Enums/RateType.php` with label 'Per Linear Foot'
Update `LineItemFactory::unitFromRateType()` to return `'lf'` for `PerLinearFt`
Add a per-LF trim `LaborRate` seed row in `LaborRateSeeder.php` (placeholder rate, editable later)
Run the seeder and confirm the new rate type is selectable on an estimate line; check for exhaustive `match`/`switch` on `RateType` that need the new case
resources: `app/Enums/RateType.php` — add the new enum case here
`LineItemFactory.php` — update `unitFromRateType` for `PerLinearFt`
`LaborRateSeeder.php` (or similar) — add the per-LF trim rate row
`grep -r 'RateType' app/` — find any exhaustive match/switch blocks that need the new case

tasks.title: Estimate edit dedup — retire the legacy 'Revise estimate' aggregate-seed update path
tasks.notes: The old 'Revise estimate' path re-seeds the whole estimate from scratch, creating duplicates. Retire it in favor of the direct-edit path.

prep.what: Kill the legacy 'Revise estimate' flow that re-runs the seeder on edit (creating duplicate lines), leaving only the clean direct-edit path.
prep.understand: Two code paths exist for estimate edits: the legacy aggregate-seed (re-runs the whole seeder, creating new lines that duplicate existing ones) and the newer direct-edit. The goal is to retire the old one entirely. Check what's already done in git — this is `in_progress`.
approach: Find the legacy 'Revise estimate' controller action (search `revise` in `EstimateController.php` or grep `aggregate.seed` / `revise` in routes)
Trace every caller — UI buttons, form actions, API calls — that triggers the aggregate-seed path
Update or remove those callers to point to the direct-edit path instead
Remove or `@deprecated` annotate the legacy action; update or delete any tests covering it
resources: `EstimateController.php` — find the `revise` or aggregate-seed action and its route
`WalkThroughEstimateSeeder.php` / `TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php` — the seeders the legacy path calls
`routes/web.php` — to see all estimate-related routes and find the legacy one
Any Vue component with 'Revise' in the name or a 'Revise estimate' button (grep `revise` in `resources/js`)

tasks.title: Estimate inline-save auto-SMS — confirm/label or make it a toggle
tasks.notes: Inline saves currently auto-SMS the client without warning. Make it a toggle or add a clear label so it's intentional.

prep.what: Stop silent auto-SMS on inline estimate saves by making client notification opt-in — a labeled checkbox near the save button so Haniel controls when the client is pinged.
prep.understand: A surprise SMS on every inline save breaks trust and creates noise. This is a 30-min UX gate: find where the SMS fires and gate it behind a boolean parameter. The `in_progress` status means some code is already there — check first.
approach: Find the SMS trigger in the estimate save handler (search for the Chatwoot/SMS send call near the estimate update path in the controller or a model listener)
Add a `notify_client` boolean to the save request payload (default false)
Add a 'Notify client by SMS' checkbox to the inline-save UI in the Vue component (clearly labeled, unchecked by default)
Thread `notify_client` to the controller so SMS only fires when the checkbox is checked; update any tests
resources: `EstimateController.php` update/save handler — where the SMS fires today
SMS / Chatwoot service class (grep `Chatwoot` or `SmsService` near estimate context)
Estimate edit Vue component — where to add the checkbox near the Save button
`notification_log` table/model — for reference on how SMS sends are tracked
